text:
incident-bot: Paging: SRE pager triggered — elevated error rate and latency on embeddings-v2 route (severity P2). Auto-created thread and alerting oncall.

nisha: I'm oncall. quick ask — symptoms?

sam: seeing sustained 5x QPS spike to /v1/embeddings from acct 'searchly' (acct-992). GPU pool 2 saturated, tail latency >2s, some upstreams reporting 429s and a few 503s.

chris: sounds like embeddings hot-route starving other endpoints. Proposal: surgical per-endpoint quota carve — throttle embeddings for non-enterprise customers by ~40%, keep chat routes at current capacity. Also consider disabling rerank for standard plans temporarily.

elaine: agreed. I can apply a per-route quota modifier. command I'll run: 
```
adminctl quota set --route embeddings-v2 --factor 0.6 --scope "plan!=enterprise" --reason "live mitigation - embeddings spike"
```

sam: executing now...
```
$ adminctl quota set --route embeddings-v2 --factor 0.6 --scope "plan!=enterprise"
OK: quotas updated (applied to 218 non-enterprise tenants)
```

support-bot: Alert: customer impact summary (last 15m) — 12 tenants saw increased 429/503 on embeddings endpoints. Top offender: acct-992 (searchly) generating 62% of the spike traffic.

nisha: good. additionally we should turn off rerank for standard plans to remove extra CPU pressure. chris — can you flip the feature flag?

chris: doing `ff toggle rerank.standard false` now.
```
$ ff toggle rerank.standard false
OK: feature "rerank" disabled for selector "plan=standard"
```

elaine: rerank off and quota carve in. dashboards showing embeddings QPS down ~45%, cluster CPU dropping, chat tail latencies back to baseline. initial 5xx counts dropping.

sam: monitoring logs — searchly is retrying aggressively. recommend temporary per-tenant connection limit on acct-992 and reach out to SE for request throttling.

nisha: @support-bot can you open a support outreach thread for acct-992 and flag as "rate-limited"? also include mitigation summary for the customer.

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-7812 for acct-992 and added mitigation notes + suggested client backoff guidance.

maya: i'm taking handoff for the morning. what should I watch?

sam: watch embeddings-error-rate (>2% reclaim), embeddings-p99 latency, and per-route token throughput. alerts: embeddings-error-rate high -> escalate. If spike returns, plan B = route-split to quantized variant (embeddings-q4f) + further carve.

chris: plan B details: route-split command: 
```
adminctl route update --route embeddings --split "0.7:embeddings-v2,0.3:embeddings-q4f" --selectors "plan!=enterprise"
```
This moves ~30% of non-enterprise embeddings traffic to q4f model with lower GPU pressure.

maya: noted. i'll keep oncall eyes on it and won't change more knobs without pinging here. leaving a 2-hour watch and will escalate if errors >2% or chat latency regresses.

nisha: thanks team. mitigation looks stable for now — closing active page but leaving thread open for any followups. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/live-quota-surgery — please attach postmortem when incident is resolved.

elaine: logging actions to INC-2407 postmortem (commands run, tenants affected, timeline).

support-bot: Noted. closing customer-impact digest in 30m unless new errors appear.

maya: got it. I'll update INC-2407 with monitoring screenshots and a recommendation to add an automated soft-throttle for embeddings spikes.
